App details

Lottery Filter

Create and filter lottery combinations using rules you choose, for adults aged 18 and over.

In the worksPlannedAndroid

What it’s for

An offline tool for adults aged 18 and over to organize number combinations and apply mathematical filters. Set required or excluded numbers, use number patterns and compare against past draws you import. It does not predict winning numbers or promise improved odds.

Main features

  • Required or excluded numbers and number patterns.
  • Save game settings and filter profiles.
  • Compare with past draws you import.
  • No winning-number predictions or promised better odds.

This app is planned. The description presents documented plans, not an app available to download. The final design and app still need approval and testing; there is no announced release date.

How to use

For adults aged 18 and over: define the game’s number range and how many numbers to choose, with one or two pools. Add required and excluded numbers and select pattern filters. Generate or enter combinations, save separate game and filter profiles, and optionally import past draws to exclude matching combinations.

Important limits

Filtering does not predict a draw or improve the chance of a valid ticket winning. Large combination spaces can take time or exceed a device limit. Imported history is supplied by you and is not an automatically verified official feed.

Offline use, permissions and purchases

The planned core functions run on the device without a JN86 account. Advertising, purchases, optional downloads and external links may need an internet connection. Offline core operation does not rule out separate service data flows.

Android 7.0 or newer is the common planned baseline. Individual sensor and platform features still depend on the device.

Permissions

Core filtering needs no camera, microphone, contacts or location. Import uses Android file selection with access limited to chosen files.

Local data

Game profiles, filter rules, combinations and imported draws would remain locally. File import and offline backup are explicit. No betting account, ticket purchase or remote result lookup is planned.

Advertising and purchases

The plan keeps every core feature free, with banner advertising and an optional one-time Google Play purchase to remove ads. There is no subscription. Actual local prices will come from Play; advertising providers, consent choices and SDK data handling must be specified before launch.

First version and later ideas

The functions above belong to the documented plan for the first version. Features mentioned below as excluded or later ideas are not promised as current capabilities.

Mathematical pattern filters and user-supplied history are included. Winning predictions, automatic betting and improved-odds promises are excluded.

Availability

This app is being created. The features described here are planned; it is not yet available to download.
